name: seafile-mcp
description: Your Seafile files for your AI assistant — libraries, folders, search, read, upload, share links. Browser sign-in, no dependencies.
long_description: Runs on JavaScript for Automation (osascript), which ships with macOS: no Node, Python or Homebrew. Signs in through the browser like the Seafile desktop client (password, SSO, two-factor — whatever your server uses); the token is kept in the macOS Keychain. Two tools — `read` (never changes anything) and `write` (upload, move, delete to trash, share) — so you approve permissions twice, not thirty times.

server_url.title: Seafile server
server_url.description: Address of your Seafile server, e.g. https://cloud.example.com. Leave empty to tell the assistant the first time.

local_dir.title: Local folder
local_dir.description: The only folder files are downloaded to and uploaded from.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Hide the write tool: the assistant can browse, search and read but never upload, move, delete or share.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Libraries, folders, search by name, read text files, versions, trash, share links.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Upload, download, write text files, create folders, rename, move, copy, delete to trash, restore, share links.
